# Heavy self-host tests — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the x86 split.
#
# These TestSelfHost* tests RUN the self-host compiler on whole programs
# (bootstrap / fixpoint / per-module / CLI / derive-stdlib / the IR
# eligibility probes). Each takes tens of seconds and cannot be build-cached
# away, so when several land in one round-robin shard the shard runs long
# enough to be reclaimed mid-run by the GitHub runner pool (exit 143,
# "runner received a shutdown signal") — the persistent red on every PR.
#
# The `test-e2e-selfhost.yml` workflow pulls every name listed here OUT of the
# round-robin `test` shards and runs each in its own short `heavy` job, so no
# shard clusters them and each heavy test runs alone in a job short enough to
# clear the reclaim window. They run x86-only (they t.Skip on aarch64 for lack
# of x86 cross-gcc / qemu-x86_64).
#
# Format: one anchored top-level test name per line. Blank lines and lines
# starting with `#` are ignored. Add a name here when a new compiler-running
# test shows up in the >~20s tail; new lighter tests need no change (they keep
# auto-sharding round-robin). The authoritative signal for "is this heavy?" is
# CI preemption itself (exit 143 on an x86 shard), not local timing — a fresh
# CI shard pays a cold driver build plus accumulated shard load that a warm
# local cache hides.
TestSelfHostStage2Bootstrap
TestSelfHostStage2Compiler
TestSelfHostStage2FixedPoint
TestSelfHostBootstrapsItself
TestSelfHostLoadFixpointX86_64
TestSelfHostModloadFixpointX86_64
TestSelfHostModloadPerModuleWholeCompilerX86_64
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleCrossEnum
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleCrossStruct
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleDriver
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleLink
TestSelfHostIRPerModuleLinkStrings
TestSelfHostDeriveStdlibIR
TestSelfHostImmutabilityGateX86_64
TestSelfHostCLIX86_64
TestSelfHostMathX86_64
TestSelfHostArrayX86_64
TestSelfHostIREligibilityProbe
TestSelfHostIRExternProbe
TestSelfHostIRPipelineProbe
TestSelfHostIRF64Eligible
TestSelfHostIRF64ArrayEligible
TestSelfHostIRF64FieldEligible
TestSelfHostIRMethodReturnEligible
TestSelfHostIRStructReturnEligible
TestSelfHostIRTupleReturnEligible
TestSelfHostModloadIRProbeX86_64
TestSelfHostX86ScaleProbe
# Added after PR #3844 — confirmed preempted (exit 143) on its own CI run:
TestSelfHostStdlibModulesIR
TestSelfHostStdTestE2E
